title: Notification bar is hard to read.

messages.text: Notification bar is hard to read. check about the css. the menu tabs on top pages already too longer. that impact about this notification display.

You're right, it's a layout bug in the console. The menu bar is too long for one row, so 'Alerts' wraps to a second row. The notification bar is set to sit just under a one-row menu, so the second row covers its first line. The fix: put the notification under the real height of the menu (and maybe make the menu shorter). It's logged as I-130 for a tools agent, together with I-129 (tables shown as raw '|' text).

What you need to do: nothing now. Until it's fixed, a slightly wider window (all menu buttons on one row) shows the whole notification.

Fixed: the notification bar now always sits below the menu, on every console page.
- The bar now follows the menu's real height, so when the menu wraps on a narrow window it moves down with it.
- The menu is shorter: all 8 buttons fit on one row from about 900 px wide (before, Alerts wrapped even on a wide screen).
- The red count badges now sit on the corner of their button, so a count no longer makes the menu longer.
- Checked in Chrome on all 7 pages at 8 widths (375 to 1440 px): bar fully visible each time (before: covered each time).

What you need to do: reload the console tab (Cmd+R) to get the new layout.
